name: x-find-review-reply
title: Find a post on X and reply to it, after you approve
summary: Search X for a topic, open the reply box on the newest post that is genuinely about it, stop for your approval, then post the comment.
description: The half of phone automation an API cannot do. It searches X as the signed-in account, picks the newest post that is really about the topic, opens that post's reply composer, and stops there holding the phone. You see which post it chose before anything is written. Approve and it types the comment and posts it, then confirms the reply went through by the composer closing rather than by the tap. Walk away instead and the composer is closed with nothing sent.
output: The post it chose, and the reply once its effect was verified on screen.

topic.description: What to search for on X

about.description: What makes a post the right one to reply to, in a few words
about.example: genuinely about the EB-2 NIW visa

comment.description: The reply, typed exactly as written. Nothing else is ever typed. You can replace it at the approval pause.
comment.example: Great summary. NIW timelines have really shifted this year.

phases.title: Find the post and open its reply box
phases.goal: In the X app, tap the Explore or Search tab, tap the search field, type '{{topic}}', and submit. On the results screen tap the Latest tab. Then, on the first post in the results that is {{about}}, tap the Reply button that belongs to that post, the Reply in the same card as its text, not the post text itself, so the reply composer opens for it. Do not type, post, like, repost or follow.
steps: The Latest tab of the results is selected
The reply composer is open for one of the posts
phases.pauseWhen: X's reply composer is open: a 'Replying to @…' line and a 'Post your reply' field are showing, with the keyboard up

phases.title: Type the approved comment and post it
phases.goal: Type the comment into the focused reply field, then tap the Reply button to post it. Do not like, repost or follow.
